tldr: Today's news is mostly Brazil and LatAm: card-rewards launches, Black Friday offers, and outages and breaches at Itaú, Banco do Brasil and Mercado Bitcoin. The items most relevant to Simplii are Mercado Pago's push into investing, Kalshi's move into stocks and ETFs, N26's premium tier, and Anthropic's IPO reaching retail investors through B3. None of the tracked Canadian competitors (CIBC, RBC, TD, Scotiabank, Wealthsimple, EQ Bank, Tangerine) made a notable move today. BMO's quantum-computing claim is the only one from that group.
themes: Premium and rewards card arms race
Black Friday cashback and points offers
Fintechs adding retail investing (stocks, ETFs, CEDEARs)
Outages and data breaches testing trust
Retail access to hot IPOs and thematic ETFs

highlights.headline: Mercado Pago launches in-app investing in CEDEARs, letting Argentine users invest in pesos and take on broker Cocos. Kalshi is buying broker FB Securities to launch stock and ETF trading.
highlights.why: Payments and prediction-market players are adding brokerage to their apps. It's a reminder that Wealthsimple-style one-app money and investing is becoming a baseline expectation, which pressures Simplii's trading and investing experience.

highlights.headline: Anthropic's IPO reached Brazilian retail investors on day one through a B3 BDR priced at about R$60. B3 is also listing a wave of thematic ETFs, including a crypto ETF slated for Nov 24.
highlights.why: Fractional, low-ticket access to marquee global IPOs and niche ETFs is setting a new bar for self-directed investing. Simplii should check how quickly it can offer new listings and thematic products.

highlights.headline: N26 launches Aura, a premium account aimed at higher-value customers. Banco do Brasil launches a top-tier World Legend card, Nubank is offering a free metal Black card to selected customers, and Bradesco is raising its Centurion fee while cutting benefits.
highlights.why: Digital-first banks are moving upmarket with premium tiers and rewards. Simplii should consider whether it needs a premium or high-engagement offer to keep and grow valuable customers.

highlights.headline: Itaú had repeated app, login and Pix outages on Nov 18-19 with no cause disclosed. Banco do Brasil confirmed a customer data leak and warned of scam risk. Mercado Bitcoin took two weeks to resume trading after a hack.
highlights.why: Reliability and transparent incident communication are differentiators, especially during peak periods like Black Friday. It's a prompt to review Simplii's incident messaging, fraud and scam warnings, and peak-load resilience.
